metas.name: ★ 9.3 · 2026 · Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
metas.description: A paraplegic ex-jockey joins forces with an outlaw to compete in the first cross-continental horse race across North America in the 1800s.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Lord of Mysteries
metas.description: Zhou Mingrui awakens in the body of Klein Moretti in a Victorian world of steam and hidden magic. As a new Beyonder, he confronts secret societies and dark rituals while seeking the truth behind his mysterious transmigration.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · The Mighty Nein
metas.description: Follows a group of criminals and misfits who are the only ones that can prevent the kingdom from plunging into chaos when an arcane artifact capable of reshaping reality falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Legend of Zang Hai
metas.description: Set in a legendary ancient time China, a man works in ruling government dedicates to civilian lives

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Gachiakuta
metas.description: In a floating city, a young boy is framed for the death of his father and exiled. He ends up in a junkyard zone, and swears to return for revenge.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Ba***ds of Bollywood
metas.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Young Sherlock
metas.description: A disgraced, young Sherlock Holmes finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy, culminating in an explosive showdown that changes his life forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Devil May Cry
metas.description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Sakamoto Days
metas.description: Taro Sakamoto was once the greatest hitman of all time, but he gave it all up for love. Now, with his past lurking, he'll have to fight like never before.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.
